papers.title: Learning how to Active Learn: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract: Active learning aims to select a small subset of data for annotation such that a classifier learned on the data is highly accurate. This is usually done using heuristic selection methods, however the effectiveness of such methods is limited and moreover, the performance of heuristics varies between datasets. To address these shortcomings, we introduce a novel formulation by reframing the active learning as a reinforcement learning problem and explicitly learning a data selection policy, where the policy takes the role of the active learning heuristic. Importantly, our method allows the selection policy learned using simulation on one language to be transferred to other languages. We demonstrate our method using cross-lingual named entity recognition, observing uniform improvements over traditional active learning.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论的是自然语言处理中的主动学习，与生物打印、髋关节植入物或有限元代理建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on active learning for natural language processing, without any connection to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习启发式方法效果有限且因数据集而异。
summary_zh.method: 将主动学习建模为强化学习问题，学习数据选择策略。
summary_zh.result: 在跨语言命名实体识别上取得一致改进。
summary_zh.validation: 跨语言命名实体识别任务实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Heuristic active learning methods have limited effectiveness and vary across datasets.
summary_en.method: The paper reframes active learning as a reinforcement learning problem to learn a data selection policy.
summary_en.result: The learned policy achieves consistent improvements over traditional active learning in cross-lingual named entity recognition.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through cross-lingual named entity recognition experiments.

papers.title: Numerical and experimental investigation into the subsequent thermal cycling during selective laser melting of multi-layer 316L stainless steel
papers.first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering & Mechanics, Ningbo University, Ningbo, Zhejiang 315211, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yang Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering & Mechanics, Ningbo University, Ningbo, Zhejiang 315211, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM过程中的热循环，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多层316L不锈钢SLM过程中的热循环行为。
summary_zh.method: 结合数值模拟与实验，分析热循环对温度场的影响。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了热循环的规律及其对熔池演化的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量温度并与模拟结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the thermal cycling behavior during multi-layer selective laser melting of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Combined numerical simulation and experimental measurements to analyze thermal cycles and their effect on temperature field.
summary_en.result: Revealed the characteristics of thermal cycling and its influence on melt pool evolution.
summary_en.validation: Experimental temperature measurements were compared with simulation results for validation.
